description: Report Node.js and OpenSSL versions and TLS-relevant environment for every running node process.

runCommand: for pid in $(pgrep -x node); do exe=$(readlink /proc/$pid/exe); echo pid=$pid exe=$exe; $exe -e 'console.log(process.version, process.versions.openssl)'; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$pid/environ | grep -E '^(OPENSSL_CONF|NODE_OPTIONS)=' || true; done
